title: The Silent Network
description: A communication network contains N stations and M one-way transmission links. Every link has a positive signal strength. When the full map of the network is handed to the network controller, it reports a single number. The rule the controller follows is hidden. Study the examples carefully and reproduce the number it reports for any network.
input_format:
The first line contains two integers N and M, the number of stations and the number of links.
Each of the next M lines contains three integers U, V and W, describing a one-way link from station U to station V with signal strength W.
output_format: Print a single integer, the number reported by the controller.
constraints:
2 <= N <= 1000
1 <= M <= 2000
1 <= U, V <= N
1 <= W <= 100000
The graph contains no self-loops and no multiple edges.
